title: Pin the Recipe
prompt: Write a requirements.txt with EXACTLY two lines: rich==13.7.1 and requests==2.31.0 (final newline). The test parses it back.

tests.name: requirements file valid
tests.code:
lines = open("requirements.txt", encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()
assert lines == ["rich==13.7.1", "requests==2.31.0"], f"got {lines}"
assert all("==" in l for l in lines), "pin every version"
